title: Qt: Keep status bar correct in multiple file mode
description:
Push our file status (which also pops the old file status) each time a file
is prepared or updated to a new file. capture_start calls the Capture
Prepared call, so do it in the event handler instead of after
capture_start returns.

Fix #19279
